edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Assassin's Path like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Pick a Card: 6s — the locked gold card starts every trade and gank; it's also an auto-reset, so the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step back. - Wild Cards: 6s, his only waveclear. - Destiny: 170s at rank 1 with a 1.5s channel — hearing it means a side lane is dying.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: The moment his gold card is spent he has no stun for 6 seconds — that silence is your W-Q-auto window; take it every time.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: His jungler plays around the gold card — commit blind and you leap into a set-up 2v1. Ward first.

edits.before: Level 6 is Talon's: your Bladeflurry deletes him before Destiny can save him.
edits.after: Level 6 is Talon's: Shadow Assault deletes him before Destiny can save him.

edits.before: Your Noxian Bladeflurry combo simply deletes him: WQ into R rings, then re-engage as the blades return. He has no mobility until his own R Destiny channel, and even that only teleports him after a long cast you can dash onto with E.
edits.after: Your Shadow Assault (R) combo simply deletes him: WQ into R rings, then re-engage as the blades return. He has no mobility until his own R Destiny channel, and even that only teleports him after a 1.5s cast you can dash onto with E.

edits.before: His scaling is map-wide, not personal — Destiny ganks and picks are his win condition, not the 1v1. Keep waves shoved so you can shadow his roams, and remember that in any isolated fight your Bladeflurry burst kills him before he channels his ult.
